drip: a single water drop falling into a puddle in a stone dungeon, echoey
haaah: a long tired exhale of steam from a kettle, a weary sigh hiss
screeeech: metal scratching a line into a stone wall, a sharp screech
thunk: a small soft object dropping through a metal slot onto a stone floor, dull thunk
plop: a teabag plopping into water inside a metal kettle, small wet plop
glug_glug: water glugging and gurgling inside an old metal kettle
clank: a hollow metallic clank inside an old rusty kettle, cartoon
wheeeeeeze: an old rusty kettle trying to whistle but only producing a sad weak wheezing squeak, cartoon
jangle_jangle: a big ring of old iron jail keys jangling, then a key turning in a heavy lock
hop_down: a small metal object hopping down off a wooden bunk onto stone, light clunk
scroll: a parchment scroll being unrolled, paper rustle
lid_pop: a kettle lid popping off with a metal clang and a big burst of steam hiss, cartoon
freeze_whoosh: a short cartoon freeze-frame whoosh hit
skitter: a tiny spider skittering its legs, quick creepy little scuttle, cartoon
vapour_steps: small metal kettle feet walking briskly on a stone floor, clinky tapping footsteps, steady pace

night_exterior: quiet night outside an old stone building in a steampunk town, distant machinery hum, soft wind, occasional faint steam hiss, a pipe dripping, no music
cell: quiet echoey stone jail cell at night, low room tone, distant faint pipe hum, very soft occasional creak, no dripping, no music

scheme_tension: sneaky suspenseful villain scheming underscore for an animated show: low pizzicato strings, soft bassoon, ticking clock, slowly building tension, mischievous and comedic, instrumental, no vocals
